learned: 2026-10-15: jaunty.com/labresults shows one product's reports at a time through a picker; the WordPress media library lists all ~1,000 report PDFs. Lab: Kaycha Labs.
notes: Filenames are STRAIN-LOT, the lot being J + a 3-letter line code (JYVC vape cart, JIPR, JLQD, JBVC, JYBD, JROC, JCCR, JYHG) then a product code and YYMM: SOUR-DIESEL-JYBD-SDSL-2609.
Some recent filenames carry only the lot (JYVC-AMHZ-2607); the strain then comes from the catalog match on the report itself.
Media titles read 'Strain [Product] LOT' (Rainbow Belts JYVC-RNBT-2608, Orange Swirl Hash Gummies JYHG-OGSW-2607) and carry the strain where the filename has only the lot, so they are tried first.
Lot prefixes name the line (category rules): JIPR infused pre-roll, JYHG/JYDG gummies, JDRP drops, JYVC/JBVC/JLQD/JROC carts. Others (JYBD, JCCR, JYPM) fall back to the report's own words.
